#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

echo "Creating release archive..."

# Get the current directory name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Create timestamp for unique archive naming
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Define archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Create the archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='.gitignore' \
    --exclude='deploy.sh' \
    -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" .

echo "Release archive created: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
echo "Archive size: $(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)"

# Optional: List contents of archive
echo "Archive contents:"
tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | head -20
echo "..."

echo "Deployment archive ready!"

send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping configuration send."
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format
    json_data="{"
    first_entry=true
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines

        # Add comma if not first entry
        if [ "$first_entry" = true ]; then
            first_entry=false
        else
            json_data="$json_data,"
        fi

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation step
validate_environment() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    echo "Validating environment variables..."
    
    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file file not found. Skipping environment validation."
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Read each line from .env.test and check if the corresponding environment variable is set
    local missing_vars=()
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key (before = sign)
        local key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty
        if [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if environment variable is set and not empty
        if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
            missing_vars+=("$key")
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    # Report results
    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
        echo "✓ All environment variables are properly set."
        return 0
    else
        echo "✗ Error: The following environment variables are not set or are empty:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"

        echo ""
        echo "Please set these variables before deployment."
        return 1
    fi
}

if ! validate_environment; then

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Get current timestamp for the release filename
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
RELEASE_NAME="release-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: ${RELEASE_NAME}"

# Create a temporary directory listing for more reliable archiving
TEMP_LIST=$(mktemp)

# Find all files and directories except excluded ones
find . -type f \
  ! -path "./node_modules/*" \
  ! -path "./.git/*" \
  ! -path "./${RELEASE_NAME}" \
  ! -name "*.tar.gz" > "$TEMP_LIST"

# Create the archive using the file list
tar -czf "${RELEASE_NAME}" -T "$TEMP_LIST" 2>/dev/null

# Clean up temporary file
rm "$TEMP_LIST"

if [ $? -eq 0 ] && [ -f "${RELEASE_NAME}" ]; then
    echo "Release archive created successfully: ${RELEASE_NAME}"
    echo "File size: $(du -h "${RELEASE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"
else
    echo "Error creating release archive"
    exit 1
fi

send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found, skipping orchestrator notification"
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format
    JSON_CONFIG="{"
    first_item=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments

        # Add key-value pair to JSON (escaping quotes)

        JSON_CONFIG="${JSON_CONFIG}\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\""
    done < ".env.test"

            echo "Configuration sent to deployment orchestrator successfully."
            return 0
        else
            echo "Warning: Failed to send configuration to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $response)"
            return 1
        fi
    else
        echo "Warning: curl not available, skipping orchestrator notification"
        return 0
    fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables
echo "Validating environment variables from .env.test..."

# Check if .env.test file exists
if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
    echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment validation."
else
    # Read each line from .env.test and check if the corresponding environment variable is set
    unset missing_vars
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -n "$line" && ! "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            # Extract the key (before the = sign)
            key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
            
            # Skip if key is empty after trimming
            if [[ -n "$key" ]]; then
                # Check if environment variable is set and not empty
                if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
                    missing_vars="$missing_vars $key"
                fi
            fi
        fi
    done < ".env.test"
    
    # Report results
    if [[ -n "$missing_vars" ]]; then
        echo "Error: The following environment variables are not set:"
        for var in $missing_vars; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo "Please set these variables before deployment."
        exit 1
    else
        echo "All required environment variables are set."
    fi
fi

DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Create timestamp for unique release naming
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")

# Deployment script to create a release archive

# Exit on any error
set -e

# Pre-deployment validation
validate_environment() {
    echo "Validating environment variables..."
    
    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment validation."
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Read each line from .env.test
    missing_vars=()
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do

        fi
        
        # Extract key (before = sign)
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty
        if [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if environment variable is set and not empty
        if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
            missing_vars+=("$key")
        fi

        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment validation."
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Prepare JSON payload
    json_payload="{"
    first_item=true

    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then

        # Extract key and value
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)

        # Skip if key is empty
        if [[ -z "$key" ]]; then

        # Add to JSON payload (include all variables from .env.test)
        if [[ "$first_item" == true ]]; then
            json_payload+="\"$key\":\"$value\""
            first_item=false
        else
            json_payload+=",\"$key\":\"$value\""

#!/bin/bash

# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation
validate_environment() {
    echo "Validating environment variables..."
    
    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment validation."
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Read each line from .env.test and check if the corresponding environment variable is set
    missing_vars=()
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key (before = sign)
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | tr -d ' ')
        
        # Skip if key is empty
        if [ -z "$key" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if environment variable is set and not empty
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            missing_vars+=("$key")
        fi
    done < ".env.test"
    
    # Report results
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "✓ All required environment variables are set"
        return 0
    else
        echo "✗ Missing environment variables:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo "Please set these variables before deployment."
        return 1
    fi
}

# Run validation

    echo "Pre-deployment validation failed. Aborting deployment."
